comment: Turns the DHL shipping method on or off at checkout.
modal: When **Yes**, DHL rates are offered to shoppers during checkout; **No** hides the carrier. Can be set per website.

comment: The carrier name shown to shoppers for DHL at checkout.
modal: The label displayed for this shipping method in the cart and checkout. Can differ per store view.

comment: Selects which DHL web-service API is used to request rates and labels.
modal: Chooses the DHL integration used for quoting and shipping — the **DHL XML** or **DHL REST** API. Can be set per website.

comment: The DHL Access ID used to authenticate API requests.
modal: Credential issued by DHL to authenticate rate and label requests. Stored encrypted and can be set per website.

comment: The DHL API password used to authenticate requests.
modal: Password paired with the DHL Access ID to authenticate API requests. Stored encrypted and can be set per website.

comment: The DHL REST API key used to authenticate requests.
modal: Key used to authenticate requests to the DHL REST API. Stored encrypted and can be set per website.

comment: The DHL REST API secret used to authenticate requests.
modal: Secret paired with the API key to authenticate requests to the DHL REST API. Stored encrypted and can be set per website.

comment: The DHL account number used for rating and shipping.
modal: The DHL account number sent with rate and label requests. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether the DHL handling fee is a fixed amount or a percentage.
modal: Sets how the handling fee is calculated — as a fixed amount or as a percentage of the shipping cost. Can be set per website.

comment: The handling fee added to DHL shipping charges.
modal: The amount or percentage added to each DHL quote, depending on how Calculate Handling Fee is set. Can be set per website.

comment: The weight unit used for package weights sent to DHL.
modal: The unit of measure applied when sending package weights to DHL. Can differ per store view.

comment: Selects a regular or custom parcel size for DHL shipments.
modal: Chooses the parcel size sent to DHL; selecting the regular/custom option enables the Height, Depth and Width fields. Can be set per store view.

comment: The parcel height sent to DHL for rating.
modal: The package height used for DHL quotes. Applies only when **Size** is set to the regular/custom size. Can differ per store view.

comment: The parcel depth sent to DHL for rating.
modal: The package depth used for DHL quotes. Applies only when **Size** is set to the regular/custom size. Can differ per store view.

comment: The parcel width sent to DHL for rating.
modal: The package width used for DHL quotes. Applies only when **Size** is set to the regular/custom size. Can differ per store view.

comment: Which DHL document (paperwork) shipping services are offered.
modal: Selects the DHL services available for document shipments. Can be set per website.

comment: Which DHL non-document (parcel) shipping services are offered.
modal: Selects the DHL services available for non-document (parcel) shipments. Can be set per website.

comment: The message shown to shoppers when DHL rates can't be retrieved.
modal: Text displayed at checkout when DHL returns no rates or an error. Can differ per store view.

comment: The DHL service used for free shipping on document shipments.
modal: The DHL document service applied when an order qualifies for free shipping. Applies when the content type is Documents. Can be set per website.

comment: The DHL service used for free shipping on non-document shipments.
modal: The DHL parcel service applied when an order qualifies for free shipping. Applies when the content type is Non Documents. Can be set per website.

comment: Enables free DHL shipping once the order subtotal reaches a threshold.
modal: When enabled, DHL shipping is free for orders whose subtotal meets the Free Shipping Amount Threshold. Can be set per website.

comment: The order subtotal at which DHL shipping becomes free.
modal: Minimum order subtotal that qualifies for free DHL shipping. Applies only when Enable Free Shipping Threshold is enabled. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether DHL is offered to all allowed countries or only specific ones.
modal: Chooses between offering DHL to all allowed countries or to the specific list set in Ship to Specific Countries. Can be set per website.

comment: The countries DHL is offered to when limited to specific countries.
modal: The destination countries where DHL is available, used when Ship to Applicable Countries is set to specific countries. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether to still show DHL at checkout when it returns no rates.
modal: When **Yes**, DHL is shown with its error message even if no rates apply; **No** hides it. Can be set per website.

comment: The position of DHL in the list of shipping methods at checkout.
modal: Controls where DHL appears relative to other carriers; lower numbers sort first. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether DHL request and response data is logged for troubleshooting.
modal: When **Yes**, DHL API requests and responses are written to the debug log. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether DHL requests use the test (sandbox) environment instead of production.
modal: When **Yes**, DHL API calls use the sandbox/test endpoint for safe testing; **No** uses production. Can be set per website.
